titulo.es: Reunión entre Netanyahu y Trump: la Fuerza Internacional en Gaza en el centro de la agenda
titulo.en: As the US pauses the war with Iran, is Trump really running out of weapons?

sintesis.es: El primer ministro israelí Benjamín Netanyahu inicia este lunes 27 de julio una visita de tres días en Washington. Se reunirá con Donald Trump el martes 28 de julio a quien tendrá que explicar su agenda marcada por ambigüedades: busca oponerse a las peticiones de la Casa Blanca para que retire su ejército en Gaza, Líbano y Siria mientras el gobierno israelí valida la presencia de la Fuerza Internacional para la Franja de Gaza.
sintesis.en: The US has fired thousands of hard-to-replace missiles during its war with Iran. We unpack whether its "arsenal of freedom" is perilously low.

titulo.es: Incendios forestales masivos en España y Francia provocan evacuación de cientos de miles de personas
titulo.en: Massive wildfires in Spain and France force evacuation of hundreds of thousands

sintesis.es: Incendios forestales de gran magnitud en España y Francia han devastado más de 25.000 hectáreas y forzado el desplazamiento de más de 300.000 personas, con España declarando estado de emergencia nacional y Francia convocando un gabinete de crisis. Los fuegos han generado fenómenos extremos como tormentas de rayos originadas por el propio incendio ('dragón de las nubes') y miles de evacuados duermen en centros deportivos y plazas de toros mientras continúan las labores de extinción cerca de Burdeos y Madrid.
sintesis.en: Large-scale wildfires in Spain and France have devastated over 25,000 hectares and displaced more than 300,000 people, with Spain declaring a national emergency and France convening a crisis cabinet. The fires have triggered extreme phenomena such as fire-generated lightning storms ('cloud dragon'), while thousands of evacuees sleep in sports centers and bullrings as firefighting efforts continue near Bordeaux and Madrid.

titulo.es: Trump recibe en la Casa Blanca a Netanyahu y Zelenski en medio de las guerras de Irán y Ucrania
titulo.en: Trump hosts Netanyahu and Zelensky at White House amid Iran and Ukraine wars

sintesis.es: El presidente estadounidense Donald Trump se reúne por separado con el primer ministro israelí Benjamin Netanyahu y el presidente ucraniano Volodímir Zelenski en la Casa Blanca, en un contexto de guerra prolongada entre Israel e Irán y de estancamiento en las negociaciones de paz sobre Ucrania. Las citas evidencian el delicado equilibrio de la política exterior de Washington, que impulsó acciones militares en Oriente Medio mientras intenta mediar la paz entre Kiev y Moscú. Netanyahu enfrenta además presión electoral interna, mientras Zelenski busca asegurar mayor apoyo militar frente a Rusia.
sintesis.en: US President Donald Trump separately meets Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky at the White House, amid a prolonged Israel-Iran war and stalled Ukraine peace negotiations. The meetings highlight Washington's delicate foreign policy balancing act, having driven military action in the Middle East while trying to broker peace between Kyiv and Moscow. Netanyahu also faces domestic electoral pressure, while Zelensky seeks to secure further US military support against Russia.

titulo.es: Ataque terrorista en el Orgullo de Berlín: sospechoso abatido por la policía tras estar en libertad semanas antes
titulo.en: Terror attack at Berlin Pride: suspect killed by police after being freed weeks earlier

sintesis.es: Un vehículo embistió a la multitud durante el evento del Orgullo en Berlín, dejando al menos una persona muerta y decenas de heridas, en lo que las autoridades consideran un probable atentado islamista. El sospechoso, vinculado a grupos islámicos locales, fue abatido por la policía en un enfrentamiento tras una amplia operación de búsqueda. Posteriormente surgió indignación al revelarse que el atacante había sido liberado de prisión semanas antes del ataque.
sintesis.en: A vehicle plowed into the crowd during Berlin's Pride event, killing at least one person and injuring dozens, in what authorities described as a likely Islamist terror attack. The suspect, linked to local Islamic groups, was shot and killed by police following a large-scale manhunt. Anger later erupted after it emerged the attacker had been released from prison just weeks before the attack.

sintesis.es: Un gran incendio forestal avanza por el suroeste de Francia y se acerca a la ciudad de Burdeos, de unos 270.000 habitantes, provocando la evacuación de más de 300.000 personas en la región. Una densa capa de humo cubre la ciudad desde hace días, afectando la respiración de sus residentes, mientras las autoridades vigilan el avance de las llamas.
sintesis.en: A large wildfire is sweeping through southwestern France and approaching the city of Bordeaux, home to about 270,000 people, prompting the evacuation of more than 300,000 residents across the region. A dense layer of smoke has covered the city for days, affecting residents' breathing as authorities monitor the fire's advance.

titulo.es: How changing environments can preserve an ancient microbial survival strategy
titulo.en: How changing environments can preserve an ancient microbial survival strategy

sintesis.es: A research group led by Tetsuhiro Hatakeyama from the Earth-Life Science Institute (ELSI) at the Institute of Science Tokyo has revealed how a seemingly self-destructive survival strategy could persist in yeast for hundreds of millions of years. By combining population dynamics theory with comparative experimental observations, the team found that alternating periods of nutrient-rich conditions and starvation can stabilize this unusual behavior over evolutionary timescales. The findings were published in the Journal of the Royal Society Interface.

titulo.es: Q&A: What influences teens' career expectations?
titulo.en: Q&A: What influences teens' career expectations?

sintesis.es: Adolescents in both the United States and the United Kingdom have become increasingly ambitious about their future careers over the past two decades, according to a new study by researchers at Penn State. The team also found that family socioeconomic background plays a different role depending on the types of occupations students expect to pursue, with relatively small socioeconomic differences among American students aspiring to the highest-status careers.

titulo.es: New WHO guidelines: up to 45% of dementia risk could be prevented or delayed
titulo.en: New WHO guidelines: up to 45% of dementia risk could be prevented or delayed

sintesis.es: The World Health Organization (WHO) today released updated guidelines on reducing the risk of cognitive decline and dementia , providing countries with evidence-based recommendations to help prevent or delay the onset of dementia across the life course. Dementia is a condition caused by brain diseases and affects memory, thinking and the ability to function. More than 57 million people live with dementia worldwide and nearly 10 million people get newly diagnosed every year.

titulo.en: Scientists revive a powerful antibiotic that superbugs had defeated

Instead of creating an entirely new drug, researchers paired vancomycin with a small molecule called pghi-4, which blocks a bacterial enzyme linked to resistance. The combination restored the antibiotic’s ability to kill drug-resistant E.

titulo.es: Detienen en Chile al último prófugo condenado por el asesinato de Víctor Jara
titulo.en: Chile captures last fugitive convicted of Víctor Jara's murder

sintesis.es: El excoronel retirado Nelson Haase Mazzei, condenado en 2023 a 25 años de prisión por el secuestro y asesinato del cantautor Víctor Jara tras el golpe militar de 1973, fue detenido en una parcela en Puyehue, región de Los Lagos, tras permanecer prófugo desde que la sentencia quedó firme. Era el último de los siete exmilitares condenados por el crimen que aún eludía la justicia.
sintesis.en: Retired colonel Nelson Haase Mazzei, sentenced in 2023 to 25 years in prison for the kidnapping and murder of folk singer Víctor Jara following Chile's 1973 military coup, was arrested on a property in Puyehue, Los Lagos region, after evading authorities since the sentence became final. He was the last of seven convicted former soldiers still at large.
